name: hinddian
description: Hindian memory: hinddian-memory MCP + SessionStart/Stop hooks for session drafts into Obsidian.

HINDDIAN_MEMORY_URL.title: hinddian base URL
HINDDIAN_MEMORY_URL.description: https base of your hinddian server, e.g. https://memory.example.com/hinddian (plain http only for localhost). Optional if you ran scripts/setup.py.

HINDDIAN_MCP_TOKEN.title: MCP Bearer token
HINDDIAN_MCP_TOKEN.description: HINDDIAN_MCP_TOKEN of your server (agent channel). Optional if you ran scripts/setup.py.
